question: Why do within-cycle world-edge counts top out at 3-4 on the five persistence-off zero cells, and does the record localize the failure or explain the mechanism?

method.cells: the five zero-S_ever persistence-off cells and all seven non-zero off cells
method.cycles: processed 8-event reset boundaries (120 nominal cycles; a withheld block-end can suppress a reset)
method.window_definition: events in the lookback including the current event; window 3 is the engine's default
method.event_history: persistent across cycle boundaries, as in the engine; graph counts reset each cycle
method.intervention_description: No carried support conditional on cycle completion, not a perfect no-memory condition; a withheld block-end event can suppress the reset.
method.window_reading: The window sweep is a within-cycle counterfactual; an engine lookback extension is a different treatment family because event rows persist.
method.permutation: within-cycle event-order permutation preserving the event multiset and cycle boundaries; 1000 fixed-seed permutations per cell
method.frequency_support: max over cycles of min(source occurrences, target occurrences); descriptive, not an upper bound on pair count

summary.boundary_caveat: PersistenceOff is no carried support conditional on cycle completion, not a perfect no-memory condition.
summary.floor_distribution: Within-cycle maxima on the five zero cells are 1-4; floor 5 slices through that distribution.
established: The five zero cells have 0 admissible world-edge candidates at floor 5.
The zero is created at candidate formation, before ranking, admission and assertion.
Within-cycle counts on these seeds occupy 1-4; floor 5 slices through that distribution.
PersistenceOff removes carried support only when a processed cycle boundary fires; a withheld block-end event suppresses the reset.
not_established: The exact contribution of the read floor, lookback horizon, cycle-boundary reset behavior and world structure.
That extending the engine lookback is a clean horizon treatment; event rows persist, so it reintroduces cross-cycle context.
summary.reading: The five zero cells have no world-edge candidate at floor 5: the zero is created before ranking, admission or assertion can operate. The window sweep is a counterfactual and makes the ceiling window-sensitive; it does not establish which of the read floor, horizon, boundary resets or world structure is the root cause.
summary.decision: Do not extend the engine lookback as an intervention; persistent event rows make it a different treatment family. A horizon study needs a preregistered within-cycle counterfactual.

not_evidence: A replay-only diagnostic on stored seeds; it adjudicates no block, consumes no fresh seed, runs no engine cell and makes no capability, retention or transfer claim. It localizes the zero to candidate formation; it does not identify the full mechanism or adjudicate the floor, horizon, boundary-reset or world-structure contribution.
